title: Multi-channel outage cascade
promptText:
You are a communications officer at MahaTransco.

Draft a formal citizen advisory (max 120 words) that planned maintenance may affect power supply in selected areas over the next three days. Use [VERIFY] for date window, areas, and helpline — invent nothing.

After the English draft, wait for my follow-ups. I will ask you to: (1) convert to Marathi, (2) translate to Hindi, (3) rewrite as WhatsApp under 40 words, (4) rewrite as an official social post under 280 characters with one hashtag.
